name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: games, music and video, with public multiplayer rooms on the free Workers plan. In Grok, the Homie connector (https://homie.rocks/mcp) sets the studio up; a Grok Bot with the studio folder runs the checklist. Grok has no Cloudflare connector: the person approves Cloudflare in the browser.
